adakkhiṇeyya.p: [Na+dakkhiṇeyya] (ti) CL=8 Not worthy of receiving a noble gift; Not worthy to receive a noble gift; he.
a: အဒက္ခိဏေယျ(တိ)
မြတ်သော အလှူကို ခံထိုက်သူမဟုတ်သော၊ မြတ်သော အလှူကို မခံယူထိုက်သော၊ သူ။

DOP: dakkhiṇeyya mfn. [ cf S. dakṣiṇīya, dakṣiṇya], one worthy of a dakkhiṇā, of a gift ; Abh 726 (dānāraho ~o); D II 94, 4 (esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo ~o añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā ti); III 253, 27 (satta puggalā ~ā); S I 141, 22* (narānaṃ devānaṃ ca ~o); 168, 16* (kālena so juhati ~e, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ~o, prob. wr ; Spk I 235, 13 : so ~e juhati nāma na acetane aggimhi pakkhipanto); Pv 21:67 (kiṃ mayhaṃ tena dānena ~ena suññataṃ; Pv-a 139, 9 : yaṃ ~ena suññataṃ rittakaṃ virahitaṃ tadā mama dānaṃ); Th 296 (arahā ~o ’mhi tevijjo amataddaso); Ja III 234, 11´ (ācariyā pana ~-ttā … dakkhiṇā disā ti) ≠ Sv 952, 21 (~-tāya); Ja III 472, 19* (ye ~ā idha jīvaloke etesu dinnāni mahapphalāni; 473, 26´ : ~ā ti dakkhiṇāya anucchavikā buddhādayo); Cp 1:7:3 (na pi bhuñjāmi bhojanaṃ ~e adatvāna); Mil 242, 4 (n’ atthi … koci satto tathāgatato ~o vā uttaro vā adhiko vā visiṭṭho vā); Vism 220, 24 (dakkhiṇā ti pana paralokaṃ saddahitvā dātabbadānaṃ vuccati, taṃ dakkhiṇaṃ arahati dakkhiṇāya vā hito yasmā naṃ mahapphalakaraṇatāya visodhetī ti ~o); Sv 996, 30 (dakkhiṇā ti cattāro paccayā bhikkkhusaṅgho ~o); Mp II 358, 12 (~o ti dasavidhadānavatthupariccāga-vasena saddhādānasaṅkhātāya dakkhiṇāya anucchaviko); Bv-a 94, 12 (dānānaṃ paṭiggahetuṃ arahattā ~-ttā āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho); — °’- aggi , m. [ cf dakkhiṇaggi sv dakkhiṇa , S. dakṣiṇāgni], the fire that is one worthy of gifts ; D III 217, 21 (apare pi tayo aggī āhuneyyaggi gahapataggi ~i); A IV 45, 17 (ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā madappamādā paṭiviratā … ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa ~i); Th 343 (juhāmi ~iṃ namassāmi tathāgataṃ; Th-a II 144, 24 foll. : āhavanīyādike aggī chaḍḍetvā sadevakassa lokassa aggadakkhiṇeyyatāya sabbassa ca pāpassa dahanato ~iṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ juhāmi paricarāmi … atha vā … dāyakānaṃ dakkhiṇāya mahapphalabhāva-karaṇena pāpassa ca dahanena ~-bhūtaṃ attānaṃ juhāmi paricarāmi … pubbe aggidevaṃ namassāmi idāni pana namassāmi tathāgatan ti); — adakkhiṇeyya , mfn. , not worthy of gifts ; Ja IV 380, 4* (ko re tuvaṃ hosi ~o); Mil 240, 21 (~-tāya).

adakkhiṇeyyatā.p: [Na+dakkhiṇeyyatā] (thī) CL=8 The state of one who is not worthy to receive a noble gift. Being not (one who is worthy to receive a noble gift).
a: အဒက္ခိဏေယျတာ(ထီ)
[န+ဒက္ခိဏေယျတာ]
မြတ်သော အလှူကို ခံယူထိုက်သူ မဟုတ်သည်၏အဖြစ်၊ မဟုတ်ခြင်း။
